post.summary: Mint a downstream API token using an Admin key
post.description: Requires an Admin key Bearer token issued to clientId. Requested downstream scopes must already be configured for that OIDC client; use POST /api/v1/api-tokens/{clientId}/scopes to append new scopes first. The returned opaque token is shown once.

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired, or revoked Admin key

post.summary: Append downstream scopes for a client's own APIs
post.description: Requires the Admin key Bearer token issued to clientId. Adds scopes to that client's allowed downstream scope list without changing existing scopes. Duplicate additions are ignored. Send 1–100 canonical scope names per request; each name is at most 80 characters, and a client may have at most 500 scopes. This operation cannot remove or replace scopes; only an administrator can do that through OIDC client management.

200.description: Full updated scope list; prior scopes remain unchanged

400.description: Malformed scope list, unknown client, or client scope limit exceeded

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired, revoked, or wrong-client Admin key

get.summary: List Admin keys for a client (administrator only)

post.summary: Create an Admin key for a client (administrator only)
post.description: Creates a fixed-permission bearer key to mint downstream API tokens, append this client's scopes, and manage Agents in the client owner's Agent tree. The key does not grant general server administrator access.

label.description: A label for this fixed-permission Admin key

parameters.description: Space-delimited. If omitted or blank, defaults to openid. Supported values are openid, profile, email, and offline_access; openid is required, and offline_access is opt-in for refresh tokens.
